toegepas.voor: sien of vashou of in jou hand
toegepas.na: sien, vashou of in jou hand
toegepas.rede_vinder: A list of three verbs takes commas rather than a repeated 'of', as elsewhere in the lesson.
toegepas.fout: A repeated 'of ... of' in a three-verb list, which the lesson elsewhere already writes with commas.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Same three verbs under the same negation, now punctuated like the lesson's other lists.

toegepas.voor: Die brandstof vir vliegtuie kom daaruit en so ook die was van baie kerse.
toegepas.na: Die brandstof vir vliegtuie en die was van baie kerse kom ook daaruit.
toegepas.rede_vinder: The tacked-on 'en so ook' is wooden for Grade 4; one subject with one verb says the same thing more plainly.
toegepas.fout: The tacked-on 'en so ook die was' is stiff for a Grade 4 reader.
toegepas.rede_keurder: One subject and one verb says the same thing more plainly, with 'baie' intact and the next sentence undisturbed.

toegepas.blok: Van die bron tot waar dit nodig is
toegepas.na: Elektrisiteit is die manier waarop die energie
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'X is hoe ...' calques English 'X is how ...'; 'die manier waarop' is the natural Afrikaans and matches the lesson's own glossary wording.
toegepas.fout: 'Elektrisiteit is hoe die energie ...' copies English 'X is how ...'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'die manier waarop' is the natural Afrikaans, keeps the meaning, and matches the decided glossary wording without touching the glossary entry.

laat_vaar.voor: Daar was niks warms in jou hande nie en geen vuur of verwarmer naby nie.
laat_vaar.na: Daar was niks warms in jou hande nie, en daar was geen vuur of verwarmer naby nie.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The second half lacks its own verb and reads elliptically; giving it 'daar was' makes two clear clauses, joined with the AWS comma.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'niks warms ... nie en geen vuur of verwarmer naby nie' is natural, clear Afrikaans; the proposal only lengthens it.

vlae.teks: Niemand kan energie sien of vashou of in jou hand uitgooi nie.
vlae.rede: 'Niemand' paired with 'jou hand' mixes persons; not changed because the previous round deliberately chose 'jou hand'.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'Later ook' is the natural order; 'ook later' suggests 'also at a later time' rather than 'also runs empty'.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Raak ook later leeg' is already natural Afrikaans; the reorder is a lateral move.
